import zipfile
import os
import sys
import re

src = "quarterly_report.docx"
out = "unpacked"

# Unpack using standard library
with zipfile.ZipFile(src) as z:
    z.extractall(out)

print("=== Extracted files ===")
for root, dirs, files in os.walk(out):
    for f in files:
        p = os.path.join(root, f)
        print(p, os.path.getsize(p))

print("\n=== Paragraph styles in document.xml ===")
xml_path = os.path.join(out, "word", "document.xml")
with open(xml_path, encoding="utf-8") as fh:
    xml = fh.read()

# crude paragraph-level scan: split on <w:p> boundaries
paras = re.findall(r"<w:p\b.*?</w:p>", xml, re.S)
for i, p in enumerate(paras):
    style = re.search(r'<w:pStyle w:val="([^"]+)"', p)
    texts = re.findall(r"<w:t[^>]*>([^<]*)</w:t>", p)
    deltexts = re.findall(r"<w:delText[^>]*>([^<]*)</w:delText>", p)
    content = "".join(texts) + "".join(deltexts)
    print(f"[{i}] style={style.group(1) if style else 'None'} | {content[:80]!r}")

import os

xml_path = os.path.join("unpacked", "word", "document.xml")
with open(xml_path, encoding="utf-8") as fh:
    xml = fh.read()

# Pretty print with 2-space indent for readability
import xml.dom.minidom as minidom
dom = minidom.parseString(xml)
print(dom.toprettyxml(indent="  "))

import xml.dom.minidom as minidom
import zipfile

src = "quarterly_report.docx"
path = "unpacked/word/document.xml"

# Restore document.xml from the original zip (idempotent; safe if file is intact)
with zipfile.ZipFile(src) as z:
    with open(path, "wb") as fh:
        fh.write(z.read("word/document.xml"))

dom = minidom.parse(path)


def para_text(p):
    parts = []
    for t in p.getElementsByTagName("w:t"):
        if t.firstChild:
            parts.append(t.firstChild.data)
    return "".join(parts)


headlines = []
for p in dom.getElementsByTagName("w:p"):
    text = para_text(p).strip()
    if text and text.isupper():
        headlines.append(text)
        for r in p.getElementsByTagName("w:r"):
            rprs = r.getElementsByTagName("w:rPr")
            if not rprs:
                rpr = dom.createElement("w:rPr")
                r.insertBefore(rpr, r.firstChild)
            else:
                rpr = rprs[0]
            if not rpr.getElementsByTagName("w:u"):
                u = dom.createElement("w:u")
                u.setAttribute("w:val", "single")
                rpr.appendChild(u)

print("Headlines underlined (%d):" % len(headlines))
for h in headlines:
    print("  -", h)

with open(path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
    dom.writexml(fh, indent="", addindent="", newl="", encoding="UTF-8")
print("document.xml updated")
